sources.quote: Material: EN AW-6082-T6 billet (alloy group 6xxx, Al-Mg-Si).
Yield strength Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa. SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01

findings.why: Drawing Rev C, which is in force, requires EN AW-6082-T6 with Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01). The offered EN AW-6061-T6 is the wrong grade. The 240 MPa minimum quoted in the 5 Nov email comes from the withdrawn Rev B (DWG-BR220-RevB), so that email is outdated and does not override Rev C.

sources.quote: APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.

findings.why: Alluminio B's approval for BR-220 at TO1 for STL covers only 6082-T6 billet. The ASL is the complete list for this part, plant and customer, and it has no approval for 6061-T6, so the proposed material has no current source approval. The 6061 approvals for BR-180 do not transfer to BR-220.

sources.quote: Any change to a requirement stated on a customer drawing, including material and finish, needs written approval from Stellantis before the change is implemented.
Any change to a characteristic designated special, to its control method or to its sampling frequency needs written approval from Stellantis before the change is implemented.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to program STL-Torino-27, which is in Annex A of the Stellantis CSR. Changing the drawing material to 6061-T6 and lowering the SC-01 yield requirement needs written Stellantis approval before shipment. No approval is in the documents. PRC-DEV-007 states that a deviation does not approve a new material source, so it does not cover this.

sources.quote: Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat

findings.why: The documents contain no EN 10204 3.1 certificate or tensile result for the 6061-T6 bar that Alluminio B offers. Someone must say whether a certificate and a test result exist for this lot.
